import json, subprocess, sys, time, os
def build(n, bodylen, cap=10000):
    body = b'x'*bodylen
    lines = [b'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0',
             b'From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t',
             b'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>',
             b'Call-ID: c%d' % 0,
             b'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE',
             b'Content-Length: %d' % bodylen]
    evs = []
    for i in range(n):
        l = list(lines); l[3] = b'Call-ID: c%d' % i
        req = b'\r\n'.join(l) + b'\r\n\r\n' + body
        evs.append({"t": i, "peer":"edge", "auth":"alice", "egress":"external", "wire_hex": req.hex()})
    return {"version":1,"config":{"accounts":[{"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test"]}],
            "peers":[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1000000,"capacity":cap},"events":evs}

for n, bl in [(10000, 800), (10000, 0), (10000, 819)]:
    doc = build(n, bl)
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    print('input size', len(raw))
    t=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/app/submission/main.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    el=time.time()-t
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print(n, bl, 'rc', p.returncode, 'elapsed %.2f'%el, out['accepted'], out['replayed'], out['rejected'], out['live'], 'outsize', len(p.stdout))
PYEOF
